body: <sf-progress-ring id="r2" label="Использовано 85 % лимита" value="85" status="warning" meter><sf-avatar slot="content" size="1/2" text="АК" aria-label="Анна Ким"></sf-avatar></sf-progress-ring>
<sf-progress-ring id="r9" label="Диск" value="83" warning-at="80" error-at="95" meter></sf-progress-ring>

checks.title: the ring is a progressbar named by label, its valuenow the value; at size 1 no percentage inside (DEV msg-1c3a4f0b): the value is the ring's tooltip, «62 %»

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); const c = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-progress-ring-content[aria-hidden]'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'progressbar' && r.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Загрузка файлов' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '62' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemin') === '0' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && !r.hasAttribute('tabindex') && !c && r.getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === '62\u00a0%' && (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-progress-ring'); const tip = document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('data-tooltip') || '-'); return Boolean(tip) && tip.textContent.trim() === '62\u00a0%' && tip.closest('.sf-progress-ring') === root; })(); })()

checks.title: meter: role meter; the avatar stands beside the ring, fitted to the content box, 2 px from the line

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring'); const ring = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); const avatar = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring-content .sf-avatar'); if (!avatar) return false; const a = root.getBoundingClientRect(); const b = avatar.getBoundingClientRect(); const line = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--line-width')); const gap = Math.round(b.left - a.left - line); return ring.getAttribute('role') === 'meter' && ring.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '85' && !ring.contains(avatar) && Math.abs(b.width - (a.width - 2 * (line + 2))) < 0.5 && gap === 2 && root.classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--warning'); })()

checks.title: indeterminate: no valuenow, the turning arc

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#r3 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'progressbar' && !r.hasAttribute('aria-valuenow') && document.querySelector('#r3 .sf-progress-ring').classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--indeterminate'); })()

checks.title: without label the host's aria-label names the ring; size 2 is the control height of 2

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r4 .sf-progress-ring'); const probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.width = 'var(--sf-ui-2--control-height)'; document.body.append(probe); const want = probe.getBoundingClientRect().width; probe.remove(); return document.querySelector('#r4 .sf-progress-ring-indicator').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Копирование' && root.getBoundingClientRect().width === want && root.getBoundingClientRect().height === want; })()

checks.title: value is a number, clamped to 0..100
chunk {done, total} shows a part of a job in per cent
a page's fill colour wins over the status; a bare 0 for the line and the gap is a valid length

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r-var .sf-progress-ring'); const s = getComputedStyle(root); return s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--fill').trim() === 'rgb(1, 2, 3)' && s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--line-width').trim() === '0px' && s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--gap').trim() === '0px'; })()

checks.title: size 3 is the control height of 3 (the featured icon of size 3), and «100%» fits inside the line (DEV look answer 2026-11-20: no space inside the ring)

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r6 .sf-progress-ring'); const c = document.querySelector('#r6 .sf-progress-ring-content'); const probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.width = 'var(--sf-ui-3--control-height)'; document.body.append(probe); const want = probe.getBoundingClientRect().width; probe.remove(); return root.classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--size-3') && root.getBoundingClientRect().width === want && root.getBoundingClientRect().height === want && c.textContent.trim() === '100%' && c.scrollWidth <= c.clientWidth; })()

checks.title: «100%» at sizes 2 and 3 takes the next smaller text step and fits the middle; «62%» keeps its step; in a compact region on a wide screen «100%» at size 2 is not drawn inside (12 px is the floor), at size 3 it fits; tabular figures keep the width
checks.covers: settings.showText with a four-character value at sizes 2 and 3 (1.7.1, DEV GB15-2)

steps.check: (() => { const fits = (id) => { const c = document.querySelector(`#${id} .sf-progress-ring-content`); if (!c) return false; const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(c); return r.getBoundingClientRect().width <= parseFloat(getComputedStyle(c).maxInlineSize) && c.scrollWidth <= c.clientWidth; }; const long = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id} .sf-progress-ring-content`)?.classList.contains('sf-progress-ring-content--long'); const shown = (id) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(`#${id} .sf-progress-ring-content`)).display !== 'none'; const c = document.querySelector('#r-full-2 .sf-progress-ring-content'); const w = (t) => { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = t; c.append(s); const x = s.getBoundingClientRect().width; s.remove(); return x; }; const tabular = getComputedStyle(c).fontVariantNumeric.includes('tabular-nums') && w('100%') === w('188%') && w('100%') === w('111%'); const wide = window.innerWidth >= 960; const size = (id) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(`#${id} .sf-progress-ring-content`)).fontSize; return tabular && long('r-full-2') && long('r-full-3') && !long('r-part-2') && fits('r-full-2') && fits('r-full-3') && fits('r-part-2') && size('r-full-2') !== size('r-part-2') && document.querySelector('#r-full-2 .sf-progress-ring-content').textContent.trim() === '100%' && (wide ? !shown('rc-full-2') : shown('rc-full-2') && fits('rc-full-2')) && fits('rc-full-3') && fits('rc-part-2') && shown('rc-part-2') && document.querySelector('#rc-full-2 [role]').getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === '100\u00a0%'; })()

checks.title: a ring whose value fits no text step («100%» at size 2 of a compact region on a wide screen) draws no inner text and names the A1 tooltip with the spoken value; a ring that draws its text names none
checks.covers: settings.showText, the tooltip of a ring without inner text (1.7.2, DEV msg-8e6b1330)

steps.check: (() => { const ring = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id} .sf-progress-ring`); const tipOf = (id) => { const t = ring(id).getAttribute('data-tooltip'); return t ? document.getElementById(t) : null; }; const wide = window.innerWidth >= 960; const hiddenOk = wide ? Boolean(tipOf('rc-full-2')) && tipOf('rc-full-2').textContent.trim() === '100\u00a0%' && getComputedStyle(ring('rc-full-2').querySelector('.sf-progress-ring-content')).display === 'none' : !ring('rc-full-2').hasAttribute('data-tooltip'); return hiddenOk && !ring('r-full-2').hasAttribute('data-tooltip') && !ring('r-full-3').hasAttribute('data-tooltip') && !ring('rc-full-3').hasAttribute('data-tooltip') && !ring('rc-part-2').hasAttribute('data-tooltip') && document.querySelector('#rc-full-2 [role]').getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === '100\u00a0%'; })()

checks.title: size 1/2 shows no percentage; the value stays the ring's (PG-10)
at every step the ring is the box of an sf-avatar of the same size (C131 (5))

steps.check: (() => { const steps = [...document.querySelectorAll('#r-ladder .r-step')]; return steps.length === 6 && steps.every((s) => { const r = s.querySelector('.sf-progress-ring').getBoundingClientRect(); const a = s.querySelector('.sf-avatar').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && Math.abs(r.width - a.width) < 0.5 && Math.abs(r.height - a.height) < 0.5; }); })()

checks.title: warning-at and error-at turn the ring a warning or an error by itself; the host says the drawn status (C131 (7))
no status carries no class (primary); neutral is grey; primary is read as the default (C131 (1))

steps.check: (() => { const none = (id) => !/sf-progress-ring--(neutral|primary|info|success|warning|error)/.test(document.querySelector(id + ' .sf-progress-ring').className); return none('#r1') && none('#r11') && document.querySelector('#r10 .sf-progress-ring').classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--neutral'); })()
